summary: Backend-only testing of CrLuys LifeStyle API. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 27 pytest test cases covering health, categories order, public products (list/filter/search/detail/404), newsletter idempotency, contact submission, JWT auth (success/wrong password/unknown email/me with bearer/no token/invalid token), admin product CRUD with public-GET persistence verification, admin subscribers & messages, and authorization rejection on all admin endpoints. All 27/27 tests passed. Verified no _id field leaks in any response via recursive walker. Verified httpOnly access_token cookie is set on login. Verified seeded data: 5 categories in exact required order, 20 seeded products.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfig: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False, yet auth uses httpOnly cookies. If frontend ever relies on cookie-based auth across origins, browsers will reject the cookie. Currently fine because frontend uses Authorization: Bearer from localStorage. If cookie path is intended, set explicit origins and allow_credentials=True.
Brute-force lockout NOT implemented on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts). Not in test scope but worth adding.
set_auth_cookie uses secure=False; acceptable for preview but should be True in production (HTTPS).
Search regex on /api/products is not escaped — a user-supplied 'q' containing regex special chars (e.g. '(' ) could cause a 500. Consider re.escape() before passing to $regex.
Slug uniqueness checked but no validation that the supplied slug matches slug pattern (could contain spaces/uppercase). Not breaking but inconsistent with slugify util.
No rate limiting on /api/newsletter or /api/contact — open to spam. Acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed; backend auto-seeds 1 admin user + 20 products on startup. Tests create transient TEST_ prefixed products/subscribers/messages and clean up created products via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 27 backend tests pass on first run. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. JWT Bearer via Authorization header is the primary auth. _id leakage check is a recursive helper _no_underscore_id() — reuse for any new endpoints. Frontend testing not requested; was not performed.
